title: When does a world model become interactive?
summary: When perception, simulation and planning form a real-time action-feedback loop.
body: Interactivity emerges when rendering, simulation and planning operate together in a real-time action-conditioned loop. A person or machine can act inside the modelled environment, observe the response and use the feedback to guide subsequent action.
